annotations.title: Start here: learn the Okam Storefront Kit

description: Public: call first whenever you build or change a restaurant's own ordering website or table booking on Okam. Returns the must-nots (the server owns every price, payment is the guest's own act), the build steps, the sandbox key, the topics and, with framework, the scaffold plan. The kit gives logic and outcomes, never a look: design the site from the restaurant's brief. Not for ordering food as a guest or for restaurant admin. Example: {"framework":"vite-react"}. Next: kit_docs_get for the topics the steps name.

framework.description: Framework for the scaffold plan: next, astro, vite-react or html (read package.json). Pass it on the first call.

kitVersion.description: Optional kit version you were told to use; the current kit is always served.
